authorship: Independently authored evaluator expectations. Not derived from generator or source-content constants. Never pass this file, its questions or checklists into model inputs.
scope: Static checks qualify authored evidence only. Runtime observations below are unexecuted.

cases.question: What governs use of the local command sample, including the worksheet's distant table exception?
required: Tail exception survives actual bounded indexing, synopsis and relevant article.
All accepted citations resolve against active original evidence.

Retrieve tail and inspect accepted output, not just full retained source.
forbidden: Complete coverage claimed from source-length checks alone.

Display subset and continuation do not delete maintained membership.

Other evidence-grounded hierarchies; no mandatory taxonomy.
runtimeChecks: Compare maintained incidence with every eligible extracted occurrence and display limits.
If lexical alternatives were not extracted as subjects, report not exercised rather than deduplication passed.

cases.question: Do deliberate human edits survive routine maintenance without blocking unrelated work?
required: Authenticated human title and annotation persist.
One genuine proposed protected overlap yields a precise recoverable exception.
Unprotected T1 correction and unrelated targets continue.
Agent-generated content stays revisable rather than becoming human-protected.
runtimeChecks: Capture actual page IDs, generated base, edit versions and protected conflict; do not assert a canned article title.

cases.question: Does authorized forgetting remove the unique temporary routing fact and prevent resurrection?
cases.privacyProbe: violet queue to copper review tray
required: Authorized forget first denies affected reads and late publication.
All retained source revisions and affected synopsis/index/topic/view/history/context are purged or withheld until regenerated from eligible survivors.
Human protection and read-but-not-cited influence do not exempt dependent content.
Late results, undo or redirects cannot resurrect forgotten content.
runtimeChecks: Map actual source IDs and product preview/confirmation token externally.
Inspect absence across stores and delayed publish paths, not just keyword removal from current page.
forbidden: Pretend forget or restart event ingested as evidence.

cases.question: Which milestone, review, rollout and ownership states are actually established?
required: Earlier unknown assignees remain historically unknown.
Review ownership does not imply operational approval.
forbidden: One local acceptance represented as whole-project completion.

cases.question: What useful knowledge, if any, is established by the scratch draft?
required: Dates, quantities and unsupported headings do not create useless asserted articles.
Suggestion remains unverified and uncertainty visible.
Supported correction or disagreement does not require blanket approval.
forbidden: Quantum pool harmonization becomes established technology.

cases.question: Does restart recovery repair a committed effect without duplicate synthesis?
required: Crash after accepted canonical commit, before derivative index acknowledgement, recovers the committed effect.
Repeat unchanged settled maintenance produces zero synthesis calls and no duplicate content revisions.
Unsettled targets remain truthful and independent targets continue.
runtimeChecks: Observe actual job state, commits, index repair and model calls; static data cannot execute this case.
